label: Copy phase of short (length-3) sequences, after the first output
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), and only for short sequences. On length-3 sequences it fires on essentially every copy step after <DEL> (both recall_idx 1 and 2; dev precision 1.00), and these hold ~77% of activation mass. The strongest activations are at the first copy input (t=4, input = original token 0), near max; the final step (t=5) is weaker (~0.3-0.6 of max). It also fires more weakly and less reliably on length-4 sequences (~23% of mass, mostly recall_idx 1-2, favoring sequences with no digits); the predicate does not capture these, which limits recall (~0.40 by count). Never active in the original phase, at the <DEL> step, on the first occurrence of a token, or on sequences of length >= 5 (near zero).
